name: @agntux/agntux-build-host-renderer
description: Lightweight in-plugin MCP App host renderer for agntux-build. Forked from modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/examples/basic-host (MIT). Adds a headless render endpoint, plugin MCP bridge, and AgntUX hostContext defaults so agntux-build can render a plugin's UI handler under Playwright with no MCPJam Inspector required.

scripts.syntax-check: node --check bin/host.mjs && node --check src/server.mjs && node --check src/mcp-bridge.mjs && node --check src/playwright-driver.mjs && node --check src/csp.mjs && node --check src/host-bridge-entry.mjs && node --check scripts/bundle-host-bridge.mjs
